name: tr_graves
caption:
IF ALLEN GRAVES WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🪨 Larvitar, the growth spurt: from 6-1 to 6-7 in one summer
🐻 Ursaring, back to back: 2 straight state titles, 19 points and 20 rebounds in the second final
👑 Nidoking, the king: Louisiana Mr. Basketball 2024
🐈 Purrloin, quick hands: 67 steals, the most by a freshman in Santa Clara history
⚡ Luxray, the spark: WCC Sixth Man and Freshman of the Year
🦖 Tyranitar, the ace: our pick 19, just 20, and 9 games into his career

Which one would you add? 👇

beats.head: GRAVES' TEAM
beats.vo: If Allen Graves was a trainer... this is his team.
beats.dlg: IF GRAVES WAS A TRAINER...|THIS IS HIS TEAM!

beats.head: GRAVES' TEAM
beats.name: GROWTH SPURT
beats.vo: First up, the growth spurt. He grew up playing football. Then, in one summer, he went from six-one to six-seven.
beats.dlg: FIRST UP: GROWTH SPURT!|6-1 TO 6-7 IN ONE SUMMER

beats.head: GRAVES' TEAM
beats.name: BACK TO BACK
beats.vo: The bear. Two straight state titles, with nineteen points and twenty rebounds in the second final.
beats.dlg: TWO STATE TITLES IN A ROW.|FINAL: 19 PTS, 20 REB!

beats.head: GRAVES' TEAM
beats.name: QUICK HANDS
beats.vo: Quick hands. Sixty-seven steals as a freshman at Santa Clara, the most by a freshman in school history.
beats.dlg: QUICK HANDS: 67 STEALS.|A SANTA CLARA FROSH RECORD

beats.head: GRAVES' TEAM
beats.name: THE SPARK
beats.vo: The spark. His conference's Sixth Man of the Year, and Freshman of the Year.
beats.dlg: THE SPARK OFF THE BENCH:|6TH MAN + FRESHMAN OF YEAR

beats.head: GRAVES' TEAM
beats.name: THE ACE
beats.vo: And the ace. Still growing. We took him nineteenth, and he's just twenty. Nine games in, and only getting started.
beats.dlg: THE ACE: STILL GROWING.|PICK 19, JUST 20 YEARS OLD

facts.claim: Grew up playing football; a growth spurt over one summer took him from 6 ft 1 in (6-1) to 6 ft 7 in (6-7); two consecutive state championships, 19 points and 20 rebounds in the senior-year state final, his second (2nd) consecutive title; Louisiana Mr. Basketball (2024); freshman at Santa Clara: 67 steals, the most by a freshman in program history; WCC Freshman of the Year and Sixth Man (6th Man) of the Year (2026); selected 19th overall by Toronto in the 2026 NBA draft; born July 28, 2006 (age 20)
